metadata.description: Victor's Company (VIC token, @VictorsCompanyBot): Proof-of-Holding mining game inside Telegram. Users verify their wallet on-chain by sending 0.05 TON with a one-time comment VC-XXXXXXXXXX.

addresses.source: https://tonviewer.com/0:F8B77951060B4083B53F758953008623A883D7453EB31EA02FA0682A4EF6185A ~120k payments of exactly 0.05 TON with unique comments VC-[0-9A-F]{10} from ~119k senders (2026-09-26..10-11). Holds 3M VIC and VIC-USDT LP; sent 15 TON to the VIC payout wallet.
https://tonviewer.com/0:0D69696BDA1E224DBC88FA4C68DE7BA5F7549FA294F1F0E8B08077F6DDB00D7D Sent ~9.99M VIC to ~6.6k wallets that paid the VC- verification fee; funded by the fee collector.
